quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Wait for the green light before going.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Watch for other cars and pedestrians.

questions.question: Yield also means stop if you cannot merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: When you must yield, you should stop if you cannot merge safely into the traffic.

questions.question: What should you do if traffic lights are not working due to a power outage?

options.text: Park your car and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you will do.
Turn on hazard lights and go through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection like a four-way stop. Let other drivers go when it is their turn, then go when it is your turn. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What technique helps drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add weight to your car for better grip.
Leave the highway as soon as possible.
Drive slower and stay further back from other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower and stay further back from other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow or ice and increase the distance between you and the car ahead. These are the best ways to avoid crashes in bad weather.

questions.question: What do defensive drivers think about?

options.text: Other drivers will do the right thing.
What other drivers might do and how to react.
They expect no favors and give none.

questions.correctAnswerText: What other drivers might do and how to react.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means thinking ahead about what other drivers might do and being ready to react to their mistakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you must:

options.text: Give the right-of-way to traffic that could cause a crash.
Yield only to cars on your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic that could cause a crash.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, let cars already in the road go first. You can go if there is no traffic coming. Be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams bounce off the fog and make it harder to see. Use fog lights if your car has them.

questions.question: Always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from a parking area or alley.

questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal when you move left or right. Signal when changing lanes, pulling into a parking space, entering traffic, or passing another car.

questions.question: After a school bus stops to drop off children, you should:

options.text: Wait for the children to wave at you.
Watch for children walking along the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the road.
questions.explanation: After a school bus stops, watch for children walking along the side of the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: When entering a roundabout, slow down and:

options.text: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing.
Yield to cars already in the roundabout.

questions.explanation: When entering a roundabout, you must yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and all traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: Do not enter an intersection if you will block it when the light turns red:

options.text: Unless you entered on a yellow light.
Unless you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can completely cross before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: To see objects in your blind spot when changing lanes, check:
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Look over the appropriate shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: What can you do from the center turn lane?
questions.explanation: The center turn lane is only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: When passing on a two-lane road, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn as you pass.
Flash your headlights as you pass.
Check the distance to oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the distance to oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: It is hard to judge how fast oncoming vehicles are traveling. Always make sure you can safely change lanes before passing. If you are unsure about an oncoming vehicle's speed, wait until it has passed and there is enough space for you to change lanes safely.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, you must yield to drivers who arrived before you.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, yield to drivers who arrived before you. Wait your turn to enter the intersection.

questions.question: You must use your turn signal when leaving a parking space.
questions.explanation: The law requires you to signal by hand or turn signal when driving out of a parking space. Let other drivers know what you are doing to prevent crashes.

questions.question: Alcohol:

options.text: Slows your reflexes and reaction time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slows your reflexes and reaction time.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows brain activity and reduces the skills needed for safe driving. It causes slower reaction time and poor judgment.

questions.question: Driving while taking medication that impairs your driving is permitted:
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of any substance that impairs your driving. This includes alcohol, prescription medications, over-the-counter medications, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: You can pass by driving on the right shoulder:

options.text: When there are no pedestrians nearby.
When the car ahead is driving too slowly.
When the car ahead is turning.

questions.explanation: Never drive off the pavement or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle. This is illegal under all conditions.

questions.question: If you drive slower than the traffic around you, what will most likely happen?

options.text: You will block traffic and may get a ticket.
You will show good defensive driving skills.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will block traffic and may get a ticket.
questions.explanation: Drive slower when there is heavy traffic or bad weather. But if you drive so slowly that you block normal traffic, you may get a ticket. Match the speed of traffic, unless the traffic speed is over the legal limit.

questions.question: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road.
questions.explanation: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are traveling. Drive carefully around children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a low ground railroad crossing. At this location, railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: You are on a two-lane road with no bike lanes and a cyclist is ahead going the same way. How should you safely pass the cyclist?

options.text: Slow down, wait for oncoming traffic to clear, then pass while leaving plenty of space between you and the cyclist.
Keep driving straight. The cyclist must get out of your way.
Wait until you reach a traffic light or stop sign before passing.
Honk your horn to alert the cyclist that you are passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, wait for oncoming traffic to clear, then pass while leaving plenty of space between you and the cyclist.
questions.explanation: Pass a cyclist the same way you pass any vehicle, but not so fast or close that you blow debris at them or push them with air from your car. Leave at least 3 feet between your mirror and the cyclist, or 5 feet on faster roads or when there are multiple cyclists. Unnecessary honking can startle cyclists and cause crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: You are exiting the freeway on a ramp that curves downward. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down to a safe speed before entering the curve.
Slow down to the posted freeway speed limit.
Wait until you are in the curve to start braking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to a safe speed before entering the curve.
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. You may not see hazards ahead, and braking while turning can cause your vehicle to skid.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to ensure you stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Apply the brakes gently with gradual pressure so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: When parking by a curb, when should you use your turn signal?

options.text: Only when pulling up to the curb.
When both pulling up to and leaving the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When both pulling up to and leaving the curb.
questions.explanation: Signal when pulling up to a curb and when leaving a curb.

questions.question: It is very foggy. You should slow down and do what with your lights?
questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off these conditions and create glare, making it harder to see. Some cars have fog lights that work with low beams.

questions.question: What is the correct way to make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the center line before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach the corner in the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, signal to alert other drivers. Slow down and stay in the right lane as close as practical to the right curb or road edge.
